description: Northern Ireland Railways NIR Signal Posts is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by OpenDataNI. A signal post is a structure that supports the NIR signals. These are visual display devices which convey instructions or provide warning of instructions regarding the driver’s authority to proceed on the railway network. Coverage: OpenDataNI. The portal files it under the publisher OpenDataNI. Its tags are Device, Display, Government, INSPIRE, Metadata. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON. The portal shows 2023-04-06 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
